text:
sam: Heads-up — legal forwarded a hardline enterprise ask: 7-year audit-log retention + proof of KMS escrow. They want launch criteria before pilot.
jenna: 7 years is outside our current retention buckets. Which customer? SOC2 request or contract-specific?
michael: It's AcmeFin. They cited regulator + SOC2/ISO reqs. They also want ability to handoff key proof for audits.
jenna: Ok. two big things: storage/ingest cost for 7yr logs, and a KMS/escrow process that doesn't expose customer plaintext.
tara: Quick prioritization Q: is this blocker for their pilot order, or can we negotiate a compromise (e.g., 3yr + legal hold)?
sam: Sales says pilot is conditional on us confirming roadmap and acceptance criteria within 2 weeks. So ask to product is urgent.
lex: From eng perspective: long retention is straightforward if we tier to cold archive + compressed provenance, but search+SLOs change. Need to define query SLA for retained logs.
jenna: Good point — acceptance criteria must include query SLA for audit retrieval (e.g., 48hrs for full export?). Also chain-of-custody proof and signed manifest for handoff.
michael: Propose we split workstreams: 1) retention-on-disk + archival policy, 2) KMS escrow process + attestation, 3) audit retrieval/manifest tooling. Each with launch gates.
tara: Proposed MVP gates: (a) configurable retention policy up to 7 yr (config + UI), (b) export pipeline that produces signed manifests, (c) KMS integration with escrow contract (legal + ops).
ops-bot: reminder: "Compliance workstreams must include runbook and oncall escalation" :alarm_clock:
lex: Engineering asks: clear SLA targets per gate. For storage: cold archive (write-only) with retention lifecycle, retrieval expected within 72 hrs. For manifest: signed sha256 + timestamp chain. For KMS: we can support BYOK with wrapped-keys; escrow needs legal flow.
jenna: I'll draft a short set of acceptance criteria. Feedback pls.
jenna: ```
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (draft):
- Retention: system can configure per-tenant retention up to 7y; data lifecycle enforced; immutable append-only storage for audit logs.
- Retrieval: Export job that retrieves tenant's audit logs for a requested timeframe and produces a signed manifest (SHA256) and export bundle within 72 hours.
- KMS: Support customer-provided keys (BYOK) for envelope encryption; documented escrow handshake and attestation; no platform access to plaintext.
- Compliance artifacts: automated evidence package for auditor (logs+manifests+key-handshake proof).
- Security: KMS integration passes threat model review + key-rotation procedures documented.
```
michael: This looks actionable. Add cost/ops acceptance: estimate delta Opex and a flag to bill pilot.
sam: Sales insists on a resumable fallback: if BYOK handshake fails, default to encrypted-hosted keys with explicit customer consent and contract checkbox.
lex: Technically feasible. We'll implement fallback policy and surface it in onboarding flow.
tara: Risks: 1) legal complexity on escrow contracts, 2) long-term storage cost, 3) search SLOs might be poor for cold archives. Call out risk mitigations.
jenna: I'll add mitigation notes and a rough timeline: discovery 1 week, design + legal 2 weeks, eng spike 1 week, pilot build 3 weeks. Total ~7 weeks to pilot.
michael: Prioritization ask to PLG: push this as "Enterprise compliance pilot" item and allocate one eng pair + infra oncall.
sam: Action items: jenna to circulate ACs + timeline; lex + michael to draft tech spike tasks; tara to sync with legal for escrow template; I'll update sales and propose customer-cost model.
jenna: sending draft now. Will follow-up with short async doc and a staging checklist. :thumbsup:
